offers_products.reason: Sells aircraft, engines, landing gear, APUs, used serviceable parts, and proprietary AerSafe/AerTrak modification kits.

offers_services.reason: Provides MRO, engineering, aircraft and component maintenance, teardowns, asset management and leasing services for airlines.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are airlines, lessors and aircraft operators; no individual or household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells and leases aircraft, engines, parts and MRO to airlines, cargo operators and lessors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue is mostly one-off aircraft, engine and part sales plus MRO jobs; leasing is a smaller part.

cyclical_demand.reason: Aftermarket maintenance and mandated compliance products are needed to keep fleets flying, though some aircraft sales can be deferred.

big_ticket.reason: Aircraft, engines, landing gear and major modifications or heavy MRO are large, infrequent purchases for operators.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from aircraft, engine and parts inventory, certified proprietary modifications and hangar facilities, not just staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are commercial airlines, cargo carriers and lessors, which are large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Holds large inventories of aircraft, engines and parts, a lease fleet and MRO hangars needing ongoing capital.

notes: Mix of asset sales, leasing and MRO; larger part judged as asset and parts sales.
